svg.title: Conditional predictive ability comparison for actual-power correction
svg.desc: Observed feedback from matching farm, operating state and model version is used to compare corrected forecasts against the base forecast. Daily paired gains are adjusted for their standard error before selecting a qualified correction.

g.aria-label: Nonnegative truncation after adding the residual to each corrected candidate
g.title: Apply the positive-part operator before storing the two corrected forecasts
Grouped historical gains enter the eligibility screen before daily aggregation and scoring.
